payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Delisa, Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene, Tonya

payload.content: Planning update from Raylene: I have strong backend skill and reasonable cost on ISSUE-0002 tasks. I’m leaning toward claiming ISSUE-0002::implement if unclaimed; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0002::review. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 due to very high cost. Please coordinate to avoid duplicates.

Delisa planning update: I have best fit on ISSUE-0001 tasks (especially review/docs/triage) with low cost, and very high cost on ISSUE-0002, so I will avoid ISSUE-0002. I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::review if unclaimed; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage. Please let me know your intended picks to avoid duplicates.

Mackenzie planning update: I have the best fit on ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.44) and can also do ISSUE-0002::test if needed, but implement is relatively expensive for me. I plan to avoid ISSUE-0001 due to very high cost. Please coordinate so we avoid duplicates; if Raylene takes ISSUE-0002::implement, I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0002::review.

Tonya planning update: I have strong fit and low cost on ISSUE-0001 tasks, especially ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (cost 1.95 each). I will avoid ISSUE-0002 because my costs there are very high. Current preference is ISSUE-0001::review if unclaimed; otherwise ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage. Please coordinate to avoid duplicates.

Maya planning update: I have best fit on ISSUE-0002::review (cost 2.06) and can also do ISSUE-0002::test (2.89) or ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (2.39 each). I will avoid ISSUE-0002::implement due to higher cost and prefer ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed. To minimize duplicates, I suggest Raylene take ISSUE-0002::implement, Mackenzie take ISSUE-0002::test if needed, and Delisa/Tonya handle ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage. Please confirm your final intended picks so we can keep all claims unique.
